name: Resemble AI
positioning: Resemble AI offers a voice API (text-to-speech, cloning, speech-to-speech, speech-to-text) alongside a now more prominent deepfake detection, watermarking and identity product line, and also maintains the open-source Chatterbox models.

pricing.model: Platform plans (Flex pay-as-you-go credits, Team, Business, Enterprise). The current public pricing page lists per-unit processing rates for detection, intelligence, identity and watermarking only; no text-to-speech rate appears on it.
pricing.headline: No text-to-speech price is listed on Resemble's current pricing page. Flex has no subscription fee and credits never expire; Team is USD 350 per month (USD 280 billed annually); Business is USD 1,000 per month (USD 800 billed annually).
pricing.headlineTier: Not published for TTS (current pricing page covers detection products)

tiers.name: Flex
tiers.unit: USD 0 per month; buy credits as you go
tiers.notes: Credits never expire; 1 team seat; platform and API access listed. Listed rates on the page are for Detect (audio USD 0.035 per second), Intelligence, Identity, Watermarker and Agent Detection, not TTS.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.unit: USD 350 per month, or USD 280 per month billed annually
tiers.notes: 5 seats; lower usage rates on select services.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.unit: USD 1,000 per month, or USD 800 per month billed annually
tiers.notes: 20 seats, SSO. The TTS docs say WebSocket streaming and the voice cloning API need a Business plan or above.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Volume pricing, SLAs, custom model training, on-premises deployment, dedicated support.

pricing.freeTier: Flex plan has no subscription fee; the page does not state a free TTS allowance.
promotions: Page banner: 'Save 20% with Team and Business plans' (annual billing); no end date stated.

voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Voice cloning API from 10 seconds to 3 minutes of audio with training under a minute; docs state it requires a Business plan or higher. Voices are selected by voice_uuid; the current model is Resemble Ultra.

streaming.vendorStatedLatency: No numeric TTS latency in the API docs. The Chatterbox open-source page states '~200ms' latency (vendor-stated, applies to that model family).

formats: PCM precision options PCM_32, PCM_24, PCM_16, MULAW

compatibility.note: Resemble documents its own endpoints (POST f.cluster.resemble.ai/synthesize, /stream, and wss://websocket.cluster.resemble.ai/stream) keyed on voice_uuid; no OpenAI-compatible route is documented.

licensing.attributionOrConditions: Chatterbox open-source models are described as MIT licensed with built-in PerTh watermarking; terms for the hosted API output were not found on pages read.

limits.perRequestCharacters: Sync and HTTP streaming: 2,000 characters; WebSocket: 3,000 characters excluding tags
limits.concurrency: REST generally 40 requests per second per token; WebSocket defaults 20 simultaneous sessions across the cluster and 20 connections per API key

compliance.note: Self-attested on the resemble.ai homepage security section: GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA-aligned data handling, air-gapped deployment and zero-retention mode. That section is written around the detection product; the pricing page lists SOC 2 documentation as an Enterprise feature.

strengths.claim: Three synthesis modes (synchronous, HTTP streaming, WebSocket streaming) with per-chunk metadata and grapheme/phoneme timestamps in the HTTP stream.
Voice cloning API from as little as 10 seconds of audio.
SSML reference with inline and wrapping tags for pauses, laughs, breaths and style.
Maintains the open-source Chatterbox model family under the MIT licence, with 23-language multilingual and Turbo variants.
Enterprise on-premises deployment and custom model training are listed.

limitations.claim: Docs state WebSocket streaming and the voice cloning API need a Business plan or above.
Earlier TTS models, including the Chatterbox API versions, are end of life on the hosted API; voices must be upgraded to Resemble Ultra.
Request size is capped at 2,000 characters on synchronous and HTTP streaming calls.

stepsToMove: Resemble authenticates with an API token from the dashboard (Authorization header) and keys all synthesis on a voice_uuid plus, for streaming, a project_uuid.
Replace synchronous calls (POST https://f.cluster.resemble.ai/synthesize, base64 audio_content in the response) and HTTP streaming (POST https://f.cluster.resemble.ai/stream, chunked WAV).
Replace WebSocket usage (wss://websocket.cluster.resemble.ai/stream) which sends JSON with voice_uuid and data and ends on an audio_end message.
Map output_format (wav or mp3), sample_rate and precision settings, and any SSML or custom pronunciation settings.
Export or recreate cloned voices on the target service; Resemble voices are identified by voice_uuid.

bestFor: Teams that want a voice-cloning API alongside deepfake detection or watermarking from the same vendor, or that want to self-host the open-source Chatterbox models.
unknowns: Text-to-speech price per character, minute or second is not on the current pricing page; third-party figures were not used.
